finding: The Pages evidence verifier previously accepted non-HTTPS deployment URLs and derived evidence digests from insertion-order-sensitive JSON serialization.

improvement.transport_integrity: Canonical and deployment URLs must use HTTPS and contain no embedded credentials.
improvement.hostname_integrity: The bare pages.dev host is rejected; only project-scoped Pages hostnames or API-authorized custom domains are accepted.
improvement.digest_integrity: Evidence objects are recursively key-sorted before SHA-256 hashing so semantically equivalent objects produce the same digest.
improvement.domain_normalization: API-authorized custom domains are normalized to lowercase with one trailing dot removed before comparison.

proved: The committed verifier source contains HTTPS and credential gates.
The committed verifier source canonicalizes object keys before digest generation.
The committed test source covers HTTP rejection, credential rejection, and key-order digest stability.
